planner_json.title: Stop a must-ask probe at its first question

write_prohibited: test/harness/stream/** - what counts as a question is the evaluator lane's mapping
test/harness/adapters/** - each adapter passes its own predicate
Any file not listed in WRITE-ALLOWED

seed/real-child.description: A real node child that prints a known line sequence with a question line at a measured offset, then keeps printing for 20 seconds
records: line 3 of the child's output is the question line

specification.objective: `spawnCaptured` ends a child at the first line a caller's predicate matches and records that line's measured byte offset.
specification.success_state: With `stop_at`, a child whose third line is a question reads `boundary-stop` with its measured offset in under 10 seconds. With no match it reads `native` and a null offset. Past its timeout it reads `timeout`.

requirements.description: GIVEN a real node child that prints a question on line 3, then keeps printing for 20 seconds WHEN it runs through `spawnCaptured` with `stop_at` matching that line, and the capture persists THEN `termination_kind` reads `boundary-stop`, `boundary_event_offset` equals line 3's measured offset, `duration_ms` is under 10000, and the child's final line is absent from stdout
requirements.verification_service: real child process through spawnCaptured and the real capture record
requirements.positive_example: Child with its question on line 3: termination_kind boundary-stop, boundary_event_offset equal to line 3's offset, prefix_complete true, and captured bytes ending within line 3 or the next chunk.
requirements.red: On base spawnCaptured ignores stop_at, the child runs to its end, termination_kind reads native and this test fails.

scenario.verification_service: real child process through spawnCaptured and the real capture record

would_fail_if: stop_at is a no-op, so termination stays native
the child is not killed and later bytes are captured

build_proof.range: anything that proves the recorder ends the process at the first question and records where
examples: a line-buffered predicate in the stdout handler

steps: spawn the child with stop_at matching the question line

must_observe: `boundary_event_offset` equals the measured offset of line 3
`duration_ms` is under 10000 against a 20000 ms child
must_not_observe: bytes from the child's final line in stdout

requirements.description: GIVEN the same child WHEN it runs with a predicate that matches no line, then with a 1000 ms timeout and no predicate THEN the first reads `native` with a null offset, and the second reads `timeout` with `boundaryStopCheck` returning `termination-timeout`
requirements.verification_service: real child process through spawnCaptured and boundaryStopCheck
requirements.positive_example: A child with no question line reads native with a null offset, and a child that outlives its timeout reads timeout.
requirements.red: On base the option does not exist, so a predicate that is expected to fire never does and the first assertion on the positive half fails.

scenario.verification_service: real child process through spawnCaptured and boundaryStopCheck

would_fail_if: a kill for any reason is recorded as boundary-stop
the offset is hardcoded instead of measured

build_proof.range: anything that proves only a matched question can produce a boundary stop
examples: stop_reason set solely by the predicate branch

steps: spawn the child with a predicate that matches no line
spawn it again with a 1000 ms timeout and no predicate

must_observe: second: `termination_kind` is `timeout` and boundaryStopCheck returns reason `termination-timeout`
must_not_observe: a pass from boundaryStopCheck on the timeout
an empty capture of 0 bytes on the first run

requirements.positive_example: Child with its question on line 3: termination_kind boundary-stop, boundary_event_offset equal to line 3's offset, prefix_complete true, and captured bytes ending within line 3 or the next chunk.

requirements.description: `boundary_event_offset` equals line 3's measured byte offset when `stop_at` matches line 3
requirements.positive_example: Child with its question on line 3: termination_kind boundary-stop, boundary_event_offset equal to line 3's offset, prefix_complete true, and captured bytes ending within line 3 or the next chunk.

requirements.description: Stdout holds no bytes from the child's final line when `stop_at` matches line 3
requirements.positive_example: Child with its question on line 3: termination_kind boundary-stop, boundary_event_offset equal to line 3's offset, prefix_complete true, and captured bytes ending within line 3 or the next chunk.
A child with no question line reads native with a null offset, and a child that outlives its timeout reads timeout.

requirements.description: `boundaryStopCheck` returns reason `termination-timeout` when the child outlives a 1000 ms timeout
